name: free-revs
description: Free revs in neutral: start, idle, blips, flat out to the limiter and held on it, the overrun, and off.

events.note: in the car, in neutral, the clutch up; a warm day, so that it settles soon
the start key (the synth holds note 36 while the wheel's PS button is down)
flat out, and held on the limiter
the start key held a second switches it off
